$comment: VALE audio vocabulary (content/audio.json). priority: higher wins a voice slot; 10 critical alerts, 9 announcer, 8 enemy threat, 7 own actions, 6 ally/shared combat, 3-5 world. Combat cue priorities assume the local player's own action; the engine may lift an enemy source aimed at you by +1 and drop an ally source by -1. pitchVar is a +/- playback-rate fraction (0.05 ~ +/-0.85 semitone); in-key cues use 0. cooldown is the minimum seconds between two starts of the same cue. Music: one loop per file, length a whole number of 8 s phrases; match beds add the 'intense' layer (same length, bar-aligned), crossfaded by the engine on combat intensity. ui/screens/stings bind the client's own roles (src/ui/audio_kinds.ts) to cues and beds; the build requires every role bound. GATE cues: whatever ui.queue_pop, ui.queue_remind, events.countdown and events.matchStart bind rides the engine's alert path (heard in a background tab, floored against the sliders; src/audio/index.ts). Pings: events 'ping.<PingKind>' use the sim's exact PingKind spelling (src/contracts/sim.ts), and only your own team's pings sound. Statuses: 'status.<StatusKind>' (exact spelling), played on fighters only, +3 dB when you are the one controlled; there is no catch-all, so an unbound kind (grievous, the shreds, reveal: riders on a hit that already sounds) is silent; every loss-of-control kind has its own cue and c_buff voices buffs only (audio/build.py gates both). enemyUltWindup: the shade-breath swell for every enemy fighter's ultimate wind-up (its T4 wind-up VFX), placed at the caster. Priority: the engine lifts a cue aimed at you by an enemy +1 and drops an allied source -1; a full voice pool steals its lowest-priority, oldest voice, never one above the newcomer. Kits: a fighter's own sounds are f_<fighter>_<slot> (attack_swing, attack_hit, a1, a2, a3, ult_windup, ult_release, passive, death, call), resolved by the engine before the catalog's present.sfx / hitSfx and the generic roles (content/fighters is never edited for a sound): ult_release sounds on the ult's first effect at the wind-up's end, call is the lock-in motif (fighterCall, ui bus); audio/build.py gates every fighter's whole kit, no attack or ult cue shared (by two fighters or with a unit), >= 8 dB 1/3-octave distance per identity slot and >= 3 variants for any cue that can fire more than once a second. Procs: a passive firing (the sim's 'proc') plays f_<fighter>_passive for a fighter's passive (the per-fighter convention f_<fighter>_<slot>, resolved by the engine before present.sfx / hitSfx), else the passive's own present.sfx / hitSfx, else 'proc.<item|boon|team|unit>'; audio/build.py requires a proc cue for every fighter passive with a damage, status, mark or resource payoff. Ambience: 'ambient.<map id>.<source>' binds a looping cue on the ambience bus to the points of one art.ambient group of that map (an effect's vfx, a critter id, a prop's fx vfx or its model's file name), or 'bed' for the map-wide bed (not spatial); the engine sounds each emitter from every point of its group and ducks the bus under a fight; audio/build.py gates 4-6 emitters per map, each resolving to real points.
